component.name: ccpager
component.summary: Trim Claude Code requests before they count against your plan

description.p: ccpager is a local gateway between Claude Code and the Anthropic API. It pages stale tool output out of each request when that is cheaper than resending it, shows your plan's 5-hour and weekly usage with a predicted run-out time, and can start new sessions on a cheaper model when a limit is under pressure.
Cache-aware paging, plan usage gauges with run-out prediction, adaptive protection of the usage limit, in-app updates, and a Debian package.
